description: This file defines a static class 'Slug' with methods to generate URL slugs from input strings by removing invalid characters, normalizing spaces, trimming to length, and converting spaces to hyphens. It uses regex methods for string processing.

classes.name: Slug
classes.description: A static class providing URL slug generation functionality.

methods.name: GenerateSlug
methods.description: Extension method to create a URL-friendly slug from a string, normalizing case, removing invalid characters, trimming length, and replacing spaces with hyphens.

methods.description: GeneratedRegex method returning a regex matching invalid characters to be removed.
